   CASE WHEN json_valid(p.observation)

name: confirmation slot settlement phase CAS
before:
AND phase=? AND (phase!='issued' OR send_until<=${DB_NOW})
        AND target_key=?
after:
AND ? IS NOT NULL AND (phase!='issued' OR send_until<=${DB_NOW})
        AND target_key=?
pattern: slot nonrelease settlement independently rejects stale phase

after: AND target_key=? AND head_sha=? AND revision=? AND expires=? AND ? IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS ?

name: confirmation slot live sender recovery exclusion
before:
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_attempts p WHERE p.target_key=outbox.target_key AND p.phase='issued' AND p.send_until>${DB_NOW})
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_attempts p WHERE p.target_key=outbox.target_key AND p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM slot_policy WHERE id=1) AND p.send_until>${DB_NOW})
pattern: slot static expired original proof and changed revision cannot bypass a live send fence
